title: RPL Target option (type 5) - all impls
notes: 2026-08-26 bounded all-implementation audit: NOT ready to claim/close. Current profile spec/05-routing.md:270 requires every RPL Target Data Length to be exactly 18, then semantic Prefix Length=128 validation. Python has a typed codec in python/src/lichen/rpl/dao_types.py:38-70 that rejects noncanonical trailing length, and dao_manager.py:1334-1342 rejects non-/128 routes. Rust's signed DAO envelope enforces type-5 length 18 at rust/lichen-rpl/src/message.rs:472, but standalone RplTarget::from_bytes (:687-706) accepts any 0..128 prefix and trailing data. Zephyr C lichen_rpl_target_parse in lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/messages.c:335-370 accepts any 1..128 prefix and any len >= 2+nbytes; production rpl_dao_process.c:126-150 does not require opt.data_len==18 or target.prefix_len==128, so non-profile targets can mutate route processing. Python/Rust/C also do not consistently reject nonzero target flags or noncanonical host bits for partial prefixes. test/vectors/rpl_messages.json currently contains no type=option / option_type=5 cases despite dormant Python/Rust vector-consumer branches, and no C byte-exact shared-vector consumer exists. Excluded C/Zephyr changes are necessary, so isolated Python/Rust edits cannot complete acceptance. Leave open/unclaimed until production C enforces exact 18-byte /128 semantics and one schema-backed positive/negative corpus is independently consumed by Python/Rust/C. No files modified or tests run because source/vector inspection demonstrates the gap.
close_reason: Implemented canonical RPL Target type-5 parity across Python, Rust, and Zephyr/C: exact Data Length 18, zero reserved flags, Prefix Length 128, full 16-byte address, and pre-mutation DAO rejection. Added a schema-validated shared corpus with one positive and four negative vectors plus Python/Rust/C consumers and codec tests; documented the strict flags rule. Gates: Python 134 passed (plus final focused 36), Rust vector and unit tests passed, clippy clean, host C vector consumer passed, pinned Zephyr 3.7 messages.c and test app objects compile with GCC 14. The full pinned link remains blocked after scoped objects by unrelated pre-existing lichen_rpl_dao_manager_process_dao_ex header/source signature divergence.
